item.title: Magic Is Reprinting a $20 Commander Powerhouse as a Star Trek Fan Favorite
item.description: Magic: The Gathering ’s Star Trek crossover set is only weeks away, and on Tuesday, Wizards of the Coast revealed five new Star Trek Secret Lair Drops featuring reprints inspired by everything from The Wrath of Khan to run-of-the-mill Klingon warriors. A sixth Drop will be revealed later.

item.title: McDonald's New 'Pokémon' Happy Meal Surprise Leaks Ahead Of Launch
item.description: Fast food chain McDonald's is expected to announce a new partnership with Pokémon in the coming weeks, and the worldwide promo will mark the return of a Happy Meal essential that's been missing in action for (shockingly!) eight years.

item.title: 30 Years Later, Magic’s Most Ridiculous 1-Mana Creature Is Still a Competitive Powerhouse
item.description: Magic: The Gathering ’s Mirage turned 30 in October 2026, and perhaps no card from the landmark expansion has enjoyed a stranger afterlife than Phyrexian Dreadnought. The one-mana 12/12 artifact creature has gone from an oddball relic of early Magic design to one of the defining threats of Premodern, the fan-created eternal format built around cards from the game’s first decade.

item.title: How to unlock Lid's second limit burst in Final Fantasy Resonance
item.description: Getting Lid's second limit burst in Final Fantasy Resonance works a bit differently than the process of acquiring other characters' bursts. With most of the party, you just level them up, and they unlock once you hit the right milestone. You can guess when that is just from a quick scan of their skill list, as a new skill usually accompanies their new limit burst at the same level. But Lid's skill list is shorter, and since the game doesn't tell you how to unlock her second burst, you might wonder whether you've missed something.

item.title: Elden Ring Movie Shrouded in Secrecy as New Streaming Deal Confirmed
item.description: A24's Elden Ring movie is being shrouded in secrecy in ways typically reserved for a new Marvel Studios project. While we're still more than a year away from seeing director Alex Garland's live-action adaptation of Elden Ring , there have been some important updates on the film, which wrapped a few months ago . But it sounds like distributor A24 is keeping many details about the film tightly under wraps as the Elden Ring movie is sent to market to strike major deals.

item.title: New Dimension 20 Season Officially Announced
item.description: The Intrepid Heroes can't be stopped. Dimension 20 's Toylight campaign wrapped up last week, but fans won't have to wait too long for their favorite actual play series to return. On Tuesday, Dropout revealed the next season of Dimension 20 will be A Starstruck Odyssey season 2 and it will start next year.

item.title: Cyberpunk 2 Listing Hints at Multiplayer Quests in CD Projekt Red Sequel
item.description: A good sequel builds on what came before while retaining what worked the first time around. So with Cyberpunk 2 , the upcoming sequel to Cyberpunk 2077 , CD Projekt Red will likely want to retain the open-world William Gibson-esque fun of its 2020 RPG while giving players something new.

item.title: GTA 6 Install Size Officially Revealed
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 promises to be the biggest Grand Theft Auto game yet, with an expansive and modern-day take on Rockstar Games' version of Miami: Vice City. The city and surrounding regions will be full of NPCs, cars and other vehicles to steal, and locations of varying seediness to visit. Expect everything to be bigger, more photorealistic, and more detailed than in previous GTA games. So expect GTA 6 to be big — really big — and clear out some storage space in anticipation of the game's November digital-only launch.

item.title: 8 MW4 DMZ beginner's tips to help you conquer Hajin
item.description: If you want to stand the best chance of getting out alive, you need our DMZ tips for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 . The series finally has a proper extraction mode and while it's not quite what was advertised ahead of launch, there's a lot of fun to be had by heading into Hajin, mowing down dozens of PvE enemies, and extracting with the best loot you can find.
